text: The Skerrow Bank wind farm off the coast of Southmere will comprise 72 turbines, project officials confirmed Tuesday as work began on the first foundation piles. The £2.4 billion scheme, backed by Northshore Renewables, is expected to generate enough electricity for more than 1.1 million homes when fully operational in 2029. Harbour Council energy lead Mara Ellison said the project would bring jobs and long-term investment to the region. “This is a major milestone for Southmere and the wider bay,” she said. Marine crews have started laying cable routes this week, with vessel movements scheduled around fishing seasons and weather windows, according to the developer.
